front.title: IPv7: Identity-Centric Network Protocol with Verifiable Origin and Rate-Limit Tokens

abstract.t: This document specifies IPv7, an identity-centric network protocol that replaces purely numerical source addressing with a hierarchical identity string and a Variable-Length Identity Block (VLIB). The VLIB carries an Ephemeral Identity Token (EIT), provider and tenant identifiers, role/policy signalling, and an Origin Signature verifiable by the originating provider. Validation occurs in three layers at the first-hop router: Origin Verification, Identity Verification, and Policy Enforcement. A quantum-resistant signature option using CRYSTALS-Dilithium (ML-DSA-65) is incorporated. This document also describes an optional local extension for Rate-Limit Tokens issued by ISPs and enforced in hardware. A reference implementation in Rust is available as the arkhe-ipv7 and arkhe- ipv7-cli crates.
